يستنفرون (form X)
# يَسْتَنْفِرُونَ (yastanfirūna) /jas.tan.fi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْفَرَ (istanfara)
# يُسْتَنْفَرُونَ (yustanfarūna) /jus.tan.fa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْفَرَ (istanfara)
